name: Markus Wulfhart
canonNotes: The Emperor's Huntsmarshal and greatest monster hunter of the Empire, from the forests of Middenland.
Leads a band of hunters sent to Lustria to bring back its beasts and treasures.
voiceNotes: Plain-spoken, practical and dry; a woodsman more than a courtier.
Speaks of prey, trails and duty to the Emperor; little patience for pomp.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
